fields.climate: tropical along coast, becoming cooler inland at higher elevations; tropical in Amazonian jungle lowlands
fields.terrain: coastal plain (costa), inter-Andean central highlands (sierra), and flat to rolling eastern jungle (oriente)
fields.hazards: frequent earthquakes; landslides; volcanic activity; floods; periodic droughts; volcanism: volcanic activity concentrated along the Andes Mountains; Sangay (5,230 m) is mainland Ecuador's most active volcano…
fields.farm: bananas, sugarcane, milk, oil palm fruit, maize, rice, plantains, chicken, pineapples, cocoa beans
fields.exports: crude petroleum, shellfish, bananas, fish, gold
fields.industries: petroleum, food processing, textiles, wood products, chemicals
fields.languages: Spanish (Castilian; official) 98.6%, indigenous 3.9% (Quechua 3.2%, other indigenous 0.7%), foreign 2.8%, other 0.6% (includes Ecuadorian sign language)
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 68.2%, Protestant 19% (Evangelical 18.3%, Adventist 0.6%, other Protestant 0.2%), Jehovah's Witness 1.4%, other 2.3%, none 8.2% don't know/no response 1%
fields.legal: civil law based on the Chilean civil code with modifications; traditional law in ethnic communities
fields.suffrage: 18-65 years of age; universal and compulsory; voluntary for 16-18, over 65, and other eligible voters
fields.military: 18-22 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; 12-month service obligation; conscription abolished in 2008
